声.meaning: A tiny <part>gentleman</part> stands on top of a <part>flag</part> at the harbour and sings. He's no bigger than a thumb, yet ships turn round, dogs stop barking and seagulls land to listen. What a huge <kanji>voice</kanji>!
声.on: One high note is so loud it rattles a steel <sound>sa</sound>fe open on the dock below.
声.kun: A <sound>ko</sound>ala in the crow's nest is so startled that it drops its breakfast <sound>e</sound>gg.

給.meaning: At the end of each month, the tailor gets paid in gold <part>thread</part>, wound so neatly it will just <part>fit</part> into her purse. She can spend it at the market or weave it into a coat. Either way, it's her <kanji>salary</kanji>.
給.on: She spends her first one on a brand-new pool <sound>cue</sound> and wraps its handle in the gold thread.
給.kun: The rest goes on a <sound>ta</sound>co for herself and a bunch of flowers for her <sound>ma</sound>ma.

圧.meaning: A <part>cliff</part> leans out over a mound of <part>soil</part> and slowly sinks down onto it, squashing it flatter and flatter until it's hard as brick. Day after day it never lets up, not for a second. That's real <kanji>pressure</kanji>.
圧.on: Deep in the squashed soil, a worm gets dust up its nose: '<sound>Ah</sound>... <sound>tsu</sound>!'
圧.kun: '<sound>Oh</sound>!' gasps the worm, as the cliff pushes down on it once again.

種.meaning: A botanist finds a stalk of <part>grain</part> so <part>heavy</part> it bends right to the ground, each kernel the size of a plum. No book has ever drawn it. She names it after herself and dances around it: a brand-new <kanji>species</kanji>.
種.on: She bites a kernel, and it tastes as sweet as a <sound>su</sound>gar cube.
種.kun: She plants its seeds in an old <sound>ta</sound>co shell and covers them with a <sound>ne</sound>t to keep the birds off.

愛.meaning: A bear reaches down one <part>claw</part> and gently tucks a <part>blanket</part> around her cub, asleep on a <part>folding chair</part>. Then she draws a little <part>heart</part> in the dust with her fingertip. All that big, soft care is <kanji>love</kanji>.
愛.on: Overnight, <sound>i</sound>vy climbs up the chair legs and wraps both bears in green.
愛.kun: '<sound>Ee</sound>!' squeals the cub at dawn, climbing to the <sound>to</sound>p of the chair to hug its dear mum.

可.meaning: A <part>street</part> sign has a tiny <part>mouth</part> tucked under its arm. Ask it anything, 'May I cross? May I skip? May I sing on the way?', and it always chirps the same cheerful answer: 'Yes, you <kanji>can</kanji>!'
可.on: Ask it whether a <sound>ca</sound>rp may cross the road, and even then it says yes.
可.kun: Ask it whether you should go to <sound>be</sound>d, and for once it says, 'You really ought to.'

想.meaning: Two inventors sit nose to nose, eyes locked in a <part>mutual</part> stare, until a spark jumps from <part>heart</part> to heart and a light bulb pops on over both their heads. They've had the very same brilliant <kanji>concept</kanji>.
想.on: Their idea: a bar of <sound>soa</sound>p that sings a long, slow song while you wash.
想.kun: '<sound>Oh</sound>!' they both think next, picturing a <sound>mo</sound>p that cleans the bathroom by itself.
